channel.title: Brendon James Kirk — Blog
channel.description: Travel essays from South Africa and perspectives on technology and culture, by Brendon James Kirk.

item.title: I Built This Website to Escape AI Slop. I Used AI to Do It.
item.description: The internet is drowning in AI slop. I built a refuge with the very machine causing the flood — a manifesto for Vibe Coding.

item.title: Howzit, Grüß Gott! A Saffa's Guide to Surviving and Thriving in Vienna
item.description: Trading Durban humidity for Viennese winters: culture shock, the German language labyrinth, and what I gained along the way.

item.title: The Unintentional Empire: How American Culture Shapes the World Without Trying
item.description: How American fashion, slang, and media shape the world without a single directive — an empire by accident.

item.title: Cape Town Calling: Your Guide to the World's Most Breathtaking City
item.description: Table Mountain, penguin parties, Bo-Kaap colour, and the Cape Winelands — a love letter to the Mother City.

item.title: Surf, Spice, and Zulu Soul: Why Durban Should Be Your Next Adventure
item.description: The Golden Mile, bunny chow, Zulu heritage and the Dragon Mountains — why Durbs deserves your next city break.

item.title: The Kruger Roar: A Safari for Your Soul
item.description: A kingdom the size of a country, the magic hours of the game drive, and what 13,900 sightings reveal about the wild.

item.title: Cows on the Beach & Hills of Green: Discovering the Magic of the Transkei
item.description: The Wild Coast: dirt roads, Xhosa heartland, the legend of Hole in the Wall, and a freedom that is increasingly rare.

item.title: The Garden Route's Green Heart: Why Wilderness Will Steal Your Soul
item.description: Paddling tea-coloured rivers, hiking to hidden waterfalls, and slowing down in the emerald gem of the Garden Route.
